description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
